All images in this folder are synthetic colored blocks and labels generated locally. No personal photos.

orientation.png: 800×600 grid with labeled quadrants, generated with @napi-rs/canvas.
orientation.heic: genuinely HEVC-encoded by macOS `sips -s format heic`, includes ftyp heic and HEIF image properties.
make-heic.swift: Apple ImageIO generator for rotated.heic (EXIF orientation 6 + irot 3) and multi.heic (two distinct images).
container-rotated.heic: copied genuine HEIC bitstream with the irot property set to 3, generated by the browser test.
rotated-reference.png: independently decoded by macOS sips.
Tests additionally set irot to 0 while retaining EXIF orientation 6 to exercise the EXIF-only fallback, and set pitm to item 3 in the multi-image fixture to verify primary selection instead of first-image selection.
